explanation: The film is set in late-1920s Hollywood, as studios scramble to switch from silent films to talkies. Kelly also co-directed it, with Stanley Donen.

claims.text: Gene Kelly dances in the rain with an umbrella in Singin' in the Rain (1952).
An American in Paris, On the Town and Anchors Aweigh are other Gene Kelly musicals without the rain dance.
Singin' in the Rain is set in Hollywood in the late 1920s, as studios switch from silent films to sound.
Gene Kelly co-directed Singin' in the Rain with Stanley Donen.
